name: Angus McMillan
bio:
Angus McMillan is a motorsport veteran with a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of racing strategy. Hailing from Melbourne, his passion for racing was ignited watching Formula 1 with his father. He started his career as a junior mechanic before transitioning into race engineering. Angus spent years honing his skills in various junior series, eventually working his way up to team management. His pragmatic and data-driven approach, combined with a calm demeanor under pressure, has earned him a reputation as a reliable and effective sporting director.

 Angus's strength lies in his ability to analyze complex data and translate it into actionable strategies. He is known for his creative problem-solving and his dedication to fostering a collaborative environment within the team. While he values innovation, Angus also emphasizes the importance of a strong foundation in established racing principles, ensuring a balanced approach to performance enhancement. He joined ART Grand Prix looking for a new challenge, and hopes to lead the team to many victories.

physical.description: Angus is a sturdy man with a focused gaze and a salt-and-pepper goatee.

quirks: Always carries a worn notebook filled with racing data and observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of coffee before every race.
